svg.title: A two-dimensional collision
svg.desc: Before: mass m1 moves along the x axis with velocity v1 toward m2, which is at rest (v2 = 0), so p1 = ptot; net F = 0. After: m1 moves off with velocity v1′ at angle θ1 above the x axis and m2 moves off with velocity v2′ at angle θ2 below it, so p1′ + p2′ = ptot. The system of interest is circled before and after the collision. An x–y axis indicator shows x to the right and y up.
